lines.text: The person makes a quick, startled contraction, immediately followed by a forceful release that sends the arms and torso upward and outward before the body settles.
The person rocks the whole body from side to side and forward and backward, allowing the arms to swing for balance while the legs absorb the shifting weight.
The person moves rapidly around the space with short running steps, sudden turns, and repeated changes of direction, as though being carried by a restless current.
The person takes a few quick steps, leaps upward with the arms reaching toward an imagined point above, and lands without arriving, continuing into another upward attempt.

The person moves rapidly through small jumps, turns, and outward reaches, then gathers the movement into one powerful upward jump. After landing, the person lowers the body to the floor and lies flat, with the arms and legs resting still.
